conviction_note: Day two of a fall caused by a Reg D placement priced at $0.30 against a pre-announcement price near $5.9. The SPA expressly permits the placees to short from signing, so the seller is not finished. There is no resale registration and borrow is scarce on a float of about 1.45m shares, so that pressure is real but not countable. One supply finding of -2.0 is cut to -1.5 because the -10..-7.5 cross-section band prior is +0.585, and the name's own history of falls is wildly two-sided (median -1.22%, mean +5.98%).

cause.what_happened: On 2026-09-28 Julong signed a Reg D securities purchase agreement: 750,000 Class A shares at $0.300 and 2,250,000 pre-funded warrants at $0.299 ($0.001 exercise), $897,750 gross, closing on or about 09-29 at 10:00 NY. That is about 95% below the ~$5.92 close of 09-28 (back-computed from the baseline's -31.93% on 09-29 and -8.69% today). It was announced on GlobeNewswire on 09-29, the stock fell 31.9% that day, and it is down a further 8.7% at the 15:04 ET screen on 3.6x volume.

pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A 6-K tonight that cancels or reprices the placement, or a named buyer (a 13D/G or a buyback) stepping under the stock. Either would take out the supply read.

positioning_check: Nasdaq/FINRA short interest was 101,017 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement, up 30.8% from 77,230 on 08-31, with days to cover 1.0. That settlement predates the deal, and the position carried into the fall will not be visible until the 09-30 settlement publishes around 10-09, outside the window. findings.finding: The placees hold 3.0m shares-equivalent at about $0.30, twice the ~1.45m non-affiliate float. The SPA expressly leaves them free to short from signing, so hedge-selling can keep landing in the 2026-10-01 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The placement closed on or about 2026-09-29, 10:00 NY, and the carve-out on future short sales applies from execution. So any hedging flow is live in the next session rather than deferred. There is no resale registration and Rule 144 needs six months, so this is only short-sale supply, not registered selling.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior placement by this issuer is in the filing list. The nearest analogue in its own tape is the July cascade: after the -21.5% fall on 2026-07-16, it fell 9.9%, 10.1%, 11.0% and 2.1% on successive sessions (baseline history). Today's -8.7% is already day two of this fall.
findings.why_not_priced: The close prices the announcement, but not a holder whose cost basis is 5% of spot and who is contractually free to sell short at any price. That seller has not stopped because the tape moved. A price that held it would show the flow exhausted: volume back near the 20-day median of $0.40m and an intraday low that held. Instead the screen shows day two at 3.6x volume, down 8.0% intraday.
findings.independence: Only weak support. Short interest was rising 30.8% into 09-15, before signing, per https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/JLHL/short-interest?assetclass=stocks. Otherwise none.

outside_window.finding: Pure dilution arithmetic says the fall overshoots: 3.0m shares at $0.30 against 21.45m outstanding at ~$5.92 cuts per-share value by about 12%, while the stock is down about 38% in two sessions. But no mechanism closes that gap by the next close, so it is not a leg-1 finding.

The Rule 144 six-month holding period lets the $0.30 placement shares and warrant shares be resold from about 2027-03-29. That is a dated supply overhang of 3.0m shares against a ~1.45m non-affiliate float.
A $200m primary F-3 shelf has been effective since 2026-08-20. It is baby-shelf limited to one third of the public float and names no ATM, so a registered takedown is possible but none is announced.
